rejected: vertical flip, because an upside-down warehouse floor is not a useful industrial view
rotation and shear, because they bend upright loads and aisles
mixup and copy-paste, because they composite objects into scenes they were not rendered in
random erasing, because it deletes parts of loads without a physical cause
mosaic_note: Small boxes and crowded images both recall worse. Mosaic stays at 0.3 so training does not add more crowding. Scale is 0.45 so object size still varies.
